title: Hold a commercial activity permit for a recreation area
what: Conduct a commercial activity in a Queensland recreation area only under a commercial activity permit or agreement.

sources.title: Recreation Areas Management Act 2006 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct a commercial activity in relation to a recreation area unless the person is authorised to conduct the activity under— (a) a commercial activity permit; or (b) a commercial activity agreement

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Recreation Areas Management Act 2006 (Qld)

sources.title: Recreation Areas Management Act 2006 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 55D, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The chief executive may grant an application to renew a commercial activity permit (an existing permit ) if— (a) the chief executive is not aware of information that is likely to change the chief executive’s consideration of a matter mentioned in section 53 for the existing permit;

reach.condition: if it conducts a commercial activity in a Queensland recreation area
